status: PROVISIONAL (measured, not yet validated by a reconstruction test)
measurement: ref/tools/analyze.py + motion_events.py, LK+RANSAC similarity at 270x480, 30 fps, all 10 videos
caveat: Backgrounds are flat colour, so tracked 'camera' motion = motion of the main content layer. A true camera move and a layer move look the same here.

element_rise_in.what: main subject (character / hand / prop) enters by sliding UP from below the frame while fading in; background stays still
element_rise_in.verified: visually on R07 9.37-9.67 s (9-frame strip) + 58 slide_up events in all 10 videos
element_rise_in.easing: ease-out: fastest on the first tracked frame, decays to 0 (R07 9.47-9.70 per-frame velocity .093 .088 .075 .057 .037 .020 .006 of canvas height; between easeOutSine and easeOutQuad)
element_rise_in.opacity: ~0.3 on the first frame, full by frame 2-3 (visual estimate)

punch_zoom.what: short scale change of the content layer
punch_zoom.confidence: medium (scale from similarity fit; small values near noise)

slide_left.what: horizontal slides, mostly in the AGE list videos R03/R04 (8 each)

static_holds.what: between events the frame is still: camera_moving_frac 0.09-0.37 per video (summary.json)
